name: Brun sieve (combinatorial sieve)
function_signature: (sifting set, prime conditions) → (upper/lower bound on survivors)
description: A truncated inclusion–exclusion sieve using Brun's pure and upper–lower truncation constructions to give the first nontrivial bounds on integers surviving congruence conditions.

name: Beurling–Selberg extremal functions
function_signature: (target sgn/indicator, band limit) → (entire majorant/minorant)
description: Explicit entire band-limited functions that majorize or minorize a target (e.g. sgn or an interval indicator) while minimizing the L¹ mass of the error, used to optimize the large sieve and explicit-formula error terms.

name: Theta correspondence (Howe duality)
function_signature: (automorphic form on member of dual pair) → (automorphic form on partner)
description: A representation-theoretic lift transferring automorphic forms or representations between the two members of a reductive dual pair via the restriction of the Weil (oscillator) representation.

name: Cyclic base change
function_signature: (automorphic rep of G/F) → (automorphic rep of G/E for cyclic E/F)
description: Transfer of automorphic representations of a reductive group over a field F to the group over a cyclic extension E/F, characterized by matching of trace formulas and twisted endoscopy.

name: Potential automorphy
function_signature: (Galois representation ρ) → (finite extension F'/F over which ρ|_{G_{F'}} is automorphic)
description: A method proving that a Galois representation becomes automorphic after restriction to some finite extension, by producing a suitable point via Moret-Bailly and applying an automorphy lifting theorem.

name: Langlands–Shahidi method
function_signature: (Eisenstein series on a reductive group) → (automorphic L-functions and their functional equations)
description: Extraction of automorphic L-functions and their analytic properties from the constant and non-constant Fourier coefficients of Eisenstein series via intertwining operators.

name: Satake isomorphism
description: The spherical Hecke algebra of a p-adic reductive group is isomorphic to the Weyl-invariant part of the representation ring (group algebra of the cocharacter lattice) of its Langlands dual group.

name: Motivic integration
function_signature: (arc/jet space of a variety) → (value in the Grothendieck ring of varieties)
description: Integration over the arc or jet spaces of a variety taking values in a completed Grothendieck ring of varieties, computing invariants such as stringy Hodge numbers and orbital integrals.

name: Mordell–Weil sieve
function_signature: (curve C, Mordell–Weil group, set of primes) → (obstruction to rational points)
description: A method combining reduction maps modulo many primes with the structure of the Mordell–Weil group of the Jacobian to rule out the existence of rational points on a curve.

name: Zilber–Pink conjecture
description: For a subvariety of a mixed Shimura variety (or semiabelian variety), the atypical intersections with special subvarieties are contained in a finite union of proper special subvarieties.

name: Tate–Poitou duality
description: For a finite Galois module over a number field there is a perfect nine-term exact sequence relating global Galois cohomology to the restricted product of local cohomology groups, with local Tate duality as the pairing.

name: Deligne–Lusztig theory
function_signature: (maximal torus T, character θ) → (virtual representation R_T^θ of G(F_q))
description: Construction of virtual representations of a finite reductive group as alternating sums of ℓ-adic cohomology of Deligne–Lusztig varieties, classifying its irreducible characters.

name: Affine sieve / property (τ) spectral gap
function_signature: (thin orbit of an arithmetic group) → (almost-prime / sieve estimates)
description: Execution of sieve methods in thin or orbit settings using a uniform spectral gap (property (τ) / Bourgain–Gamburd expansion) for the associated arithmetic quotients.

name: Modular method (Frey curve)
function_signature: (putative Diophantine solution) → (contradiction via modularity + level-lowering)
description: Attaches a Frey elliptic curve to a hypothetical solution of a Diophantine equation and derives a contradiction by combining modularity with Ribet's level-lowering to forbid the resulting modular form.

name: Caffarelli–Silvestre extension
function_signature: (boundary datum on ℝⁿ) → (degenerate elliptic extension on ℝⁿ⁺¹ realizing (−Δ)^s)
description: Realizes the fractional Laplacian (−Δ)^s as the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map of a degenerate elliptic harmonic extension into one extra dimension with an A₂ weight.

name: T(b) theorem
description: A singular integral operator is L²-bounded if it satisfies a weak boundedness property and Tb, T*b lie in BMO for suitable para-accretive functions b, generalizing the T(1) theorem.

name: Restriction/extension estimates (Stein program)
function_signature: (measure on a curved hypersurface) → (Lᵖ→L^q bound for the extension operator)
description: Bounding the Fourier extension operator from L^q of a curved hypersurface to Lᵖ of physical space, encoding the oscillatory-integral cancellation due to curvature.

name: Wave packet analysis
function_signature: (solution or operator) → (decomposition into space-frequency-localized packets)
description: Decomposes a function, solution, or operator into space-and-frequency localized wave packets that travel along light rays or bicharacteristics, respecting the uncertainty principle.

name: Sparse domination
function_signature: (singular/maximal operator) → (pointwise bound by a positive sparse operator)
description: Bounds an operator pointwise (or in a bilinear form) by a positive sum of averages over a sparse family of cubes, immediately yielding sharp weighted (Aₚ) inequalities.

name: Carleson time-frequency / tile analysis
function_signature: (modulation-invariant operator) → (Lᵖ bound via tree/forest organization)
description: Proves bounds for modulation-invariant operators (e.g. the Carleson operator, bilinear Hilbert transform) by organizing phase-plane tiles into trees and forests controlled by mass and energy estimates.

name: Profile decomposition
function_signature: (bounded sequence in a critical space) → (sum of orthogonal rescaled profiles + small remainder)
description: Writes a bounded sequence in a scale-invariant space as a sum of asymptotically orthogonal translated and rescaled profiles plus a remainder small in the relevant norm.

name: Bootstrap / continuity argument
function_signature: (maximal interval where an estimate holds) → (estimate holds on the whole domain)
description: Assumes a quantitative bound on the maximal connected set where it holds, then strictly improves it there, using openness and closedness to force the set to be the entire domain.

name: Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction
function_signature: (nonlinear equation with Fredholm linearization) → (finite-dimensional bifurcation equation)
description: Splits a nonlinear equation along the kernel and range of its Fredholm linearization, solving the range part by the implicit function theorem to reduce to a finite-dimensional problem.

name: Nehari manifold method
function_signature: (variational functional) → (ground-state critical point on the Nehari constraint)
description: Minimizes a functional over the Nehari manifold (where the functional's derivative annihilates the solution direction) using fibering maps to obtain ground-state solutions.

name: Malliavin calculus
function_signature: (functional on Wiener space) → (integration-by-parts formula / density / CLT)
description: A differential calculus on Gaussian (Wiener) space built from the Malliavin derivative and its Skorokhod-integral adjoint, yielding integration-by-parts formulas for laws, smoothness of densities, and quantitative CLTs.

name: Stochastic quantization
function_signature: (Euclidean action S) → (invariant measure of a Langevin SPDE = QFT measure)
description: Constructs a Euclidean quantum field theory measure as the invariant measure of a Langevin-type stochastic PDE driven by space-time white noise, after renormalization.

name: Replica / cavity method
function_signature: (disordered system Hamiltonian) → (free energy / overlap distribution)
description: Computes free energies and order parameters of disordered spin systems either by the replica trick with replica-symmetry-breaking ansätze or by self-consistent cavity (one-spin-removal) recursions.

name: Infrared bound / continuous symmetry breaking
function_signature: (reflection-positive Gibbs state) → (bound on the two-point function in Fourier space)
description: Bounds the Fourier transform of the two-point function by the Gaussian-domination estimate, proving existence of long-range order and spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry in d ≥ 3.

name: Reflection positivity
function_signature: (reflection-symmetric statistical-mechanics model) → (chessboard estimates / infrared bounds)
description: Exploits positivity of expectations under a reflection of the lattice to derive chessboard estimates, Gaussian domination, and infrared bounds proving phase transitions.

name: Constructive QFT / phase-cell expansion
function_signature: (formal Euclidean action) → (rigorously constructed interacting field measure)
description: Builds interacting Euclidean quantum field measures through multiscale phase-cell and cluster expansions together with renormalization, controlling the infinite-volume and continuum limits.

name: Renormalization group (Wilson–Kadanoff)
function_signature: (effective action at one scale) → (effective action at the next, coarser scale)
description: Iteratively integrates out short-distance degrees of freedom and rescales, generating a flow of effective actions whose fixed points govern universality and critical exponents.

name: Mountain-pass linking / index theory
function_signature: (indefinite C¹ functional with linking geometry) → (min-max critical point)
description: A min-max critical point theory for strongly indefinite functionals using linking pairs of sets and topological indices (genus, cohomological index) in place of mountain-pass geometry.

name: Rödl nibble (semi-random method)
function_signature: (hypergraph / design constraints) → (near-optimal packing or cover)
description: Builds a combinatorial structure in many small random increments, tracking key quantities by concentration of measure to achieve asymptotically optimal packings or colorings.

name: Algebraic shifting / Stanley–Reisner method
function_signature: (simplicial complex) → (shifted complex / squarefree monomial ideal with same f-vector)
description: Associates to a simplicial complex a combinatorially shifted complex (via exterior or symmetric algebraic shifting) and a Stanley–Reisner ideal, transferring f-vector and Betti-number questions into commutative algebra.

name: Topological combinatorics / Borsuk–Ulam method
function_signature: (combinatorial existence statement) → (topological obstruction via equivariant map)
description: Reduces combinatorial existence or lower-bound statements to topological obstructions, typically by applying the Borsuk–Ulam theorem or Z/2-equivariance to an associated configuration/test space.

name: h-principle (Gromov)
function_signature: (partial differential relation) → (solution reduced to a homotopy problem)
description: Reduces solving a partial differential relation to the existence of a formal (jet-level) solution up to homotopy, realized via tools such as convex integration and holonomic approximation.

name: Gromov–Hausdorff convergence and collapsing
function_signature: (sequence of metric spaces with bounded geometry) → (Gromov–Hausdorff limit space)
description: Takes limits of Riemannian manifolds or metric spaces in the Gromov–Hausdorff metric, using precompactness and controlling degeneration and dimension collapse via curvature and injectivity-radius bounds.

name: Heegaard Floer homology
function_signature: (3-manifold / knot via Heegaard diagram) → (graded Floer homology invariant)
description: Invariants of 3-manifolds and knots defined as the Lagrangian Floer homology of two tori in the symmetric product of a pointed Heegaard surface.

name: Donaldson gauge theory
function_signature: (smooth 4-manifold) → (Donaldson polynomial invariants)
description: Studies smooth 4-manifolds via the moduli spaces of anti-self-dual (instanton) connections on principal SU(2)/SO(3) bundles, extracting Donaldson polynomial invariants.

name: Persistent homology
function_signature: (filtered space / point cloud) → (barcode / persistence diagram)
description: Tracks the birth and death of homology classes across a filtration to produce a stable multiscale barcode or persistence diagram of topological features.

name: Normal surface theory
function_signature: (triangulated 3-manifold) → (surfaces as integer solutions of matching equations)
description: Represents embedded surfaces in a triangulated 3-manifold by their normal intersections with tetrahedra, encoding them as nonnegative integer solutions of linear matching/quadrilateral equations.

name: Inner model theory / fine structure
function_signature: (large-cardinal hypothesis) → (canonical minimal inner model)
description: Constructs canonical minimal inner models (L, extender/core models) and analyzes them level-by-level through Jensen's fine structure and the comparison of iterable mice.

name: Idempotent ultrafilter method
function_signature: (semigroup with Stone–Čech compactification) → (partition-regular configuration)
description: Uses idempotent ultrafilters in the compact right-topological semigroup βS to prove partition-regularity results such as Hindman's finite-sums theorem.

name: Spectral sparsification
function_signature: (graph Laplacian L) → (sparse reweighted Laplacian L̃ with L̃ ≈_{1±ε} L)
description: Approximates a graph's Laplacian by that of a sparse reweighted subgraph preserving every quadratic form to within a factor (1±ε), via effective-resistance sampling or matrix concentration.

name: Multiplicative weights update method
function_signature: (experts/constraints with losses) → (near-optimal decision with low regret)
description: Iteratively multiplies the weights of experts or constraints by factors depending on their observed loss, converging to near-optimal decisions with provable regret bounds.

name: Sum-of-squares hierarchy (Lasserre)
function_signature: (polynomial optimization problem, degree d) → (SDP relaxation / SOS certificate)
description: Approximates polynomial optimization by a hierarchy of semidefinite relaxations that certify nonnegativity as sums of squares, with completeness guaranteed by Positivstellensatz duality.

name: Smoothed analysis
function_signature: (worst-case input + random perturbation) → (expected polynomial performance bound)
description: Analyzes an algorithm's performance on worst-case inputs subjected to a small random perturbation, interpolating between worst-case and average-case to explain practical efficiency.

name: Interlacing families of polynomials (MSS)
function_signature: (family of real-rooted characteristic polynomials) → (member with bounded largest root)
description: Proves existence of a structure with small eigenvalues by exhibiting an interlacing family whose average characteristic polynomial is real-rooted, so some member's largest root is at most that of the average.
